annotations.title: Link preview metadata for a page

description: Fetch a public web page's head and return link-preview metadata: title, description, site name, type, preview image, canonical URL, language, author, published time, favicon, theme colour, and every OpenGraph and Twitter-card field. Reads at most 512 KB and never runs JavaScript. Use to build link previews, label citations or check how a URL will unfurl before sharing it. Example: url=https://github.com/. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the page
